name: Essential Comprehensive
named_driver_requirements: All drivers must be named at inception. Additional drivers under 25 not permitted on this product.
exclusions: modified vehicles not disclosed at quote
driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
unnamed drivers
racing, track days, or timed events
commercial use including food delivery
theft where keys were left in or on the vehicle

name: Plus Comprehensive
named_driver_requirements: Named drivers aged 21+ permitted. Drivers under 21 require underwriter referral.
exclusions: modified vehicles not disclosed at quote
driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
unnamed drivers
racing, track days, or timed events
use as a taxi or private hire vehicle
damage caused while driving without a valid MOT

name: Guard Third-Party Fire & Theft
named_driver_requirements: Policyholder plus one named driver only. Both must be aged 25+ with 2 years' continuous NCD.
exclusions: own-vehicle accidental damage not covered under TPFT
driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
unnamed drivers
vehicles with undeclared performance modifications
commercial courier or delivery use
theft without forced entry evidence unless vehicle was locked

name: Select Comprehensive
named_driver_requirements: Up to 4 named drivers. Young drivers (17–24) accepted subject to higher excess of £500.
exclusions: driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
racing, track days, or timed events
failure to disclose previous claims or convictions
use for hire and reward
damage occurring outside the UK beyond foreign_use_days entitlement

name: Flex Comprehensive
named_driver_requirements: Any driver aged 25+ with the policyholder's permission (open drive 25+). Drivers under 25 must be named.
exclusions: modified exhaust, suspension, or ECU remap not declared
driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
drivers under 25 who are not named on the policy
business mileage above declared annual limit
theft of unlocked vehicle contents left in plain sight

name: Lite Third-Party Only
named_driver_requirements: Named drivers only. Minimum age 23. Provisional licence holders not accepted.
exclusions: damage to the insured vehicle (third-party only)
fire damage to the insured vehicle
theft of the insured vehicle
driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
unnamed drivers
driving abroad

name: Prestige Comprehensive
named_driver_requirements: Up to 6 named drivers aged 25+. Agreed-value option available for classic and prestige vehicles.
exclusions: driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
racing, track days, or timed events
undeclared vehicle modifications affecting performance or appearance
use as a chauffeur or private hire without business endorsement
claims arising from incorrect fuel being put in the vehicle (misfuelling not covered on this product)

name: Classic Fire & Theft
named_driver_requirements: Limited to policyholder and spouse/partner only. Vehicle must be garaged overnight unless overnight street parking is endorsed.
exclusions: own-vehicle accidental damage not covered under TPFT
driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
unnamed drivers
vehicles stored outdoors overnight without street-parking endorsement
modifications to classic vehicles without agreed-value reassessment
lay-up periods exceeding 90 days without notifying the insurer

name: Family Comprehensive
named_driver_requirements: Designed for multi-car households. Up to 5 named drivers including learner drivers with a qualified supervisor named on the policy.
exclusions: driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
learner drivers without a qualified supervising driver present
unnamed drivers
business use beyond class 1 commuting and personal business
aftermarket audio systems valued above the audio_equipment limit unless declared

name: Commuter Comprehensive
named_driver_requirements: Policyholder only by default. One additional named driver aged 25+ can be added for a surcharge.
exclusions: modified vehicles not disclosed at quote
driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
unnamed drivers
commercial use including food delivery
claims for windscreen damage where previous unrepaired chips were not reported
parking-related damage in unsecured overnight locations if vehicle was declared as garaged

name: Modder Friendly Comprehensive
named_driver_requirements: Named drivers only, aged 21+. All cosmetic and performance modifications must be listed on the schedule.
exclusions: modifications not listed on the policy schedule
driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
unnamed drivers
racing, track days, or timed events
nitrous oxide or forced-induction systems not factory-fitted and undeclared
use for hire and reward or peer-to-peer car sharing

name: Light Commercial Fire & Theft
named_driver_requirements: Up to 3 named commercial drivers. Each driver must hold a valid licence for the vehicle class and have no more than 6 penalty points.
exclusions: own-vehicle accidental damage not covered under TPFT
driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
unnamed drivers
carriage of hazardous goods without special endorsement
theft of tools or cargo from an unlocked van
personal leisure use outside declared business class of use
